experiment.topic: BTC-USD hourly relative strength vs SPY
experiment.hypothesis: When BTC-USD's 12-hour relative strength to SPY exceeds 5% above its 12-hour mean, BTC-USD will close higher in the next hour.

test.note: No misleading proxy: hypothesis requires unavailable inputs or rule expression.

experiment.falsification_test: If BTC-USD's 12-hour relative strength to SPY is within 5% of its 12-hour mean, and BTC-USD closes lower in the next hour, the hypothesis is falsified.
